turns.content: Describe a hyperbolic Earth-to-Mars flyby orbit and relate its travel time to that orbit's period.
Using r_E = 1.50 × 10^11 m and r_M = 2.28 × 10^11 m, calculate the semimajor axis.
Using G = 6.67 × 10^-11 m³ kg^-1 s^-2 and M_sun = 1.99 × 10^30 kg, calculate μ_sun and restate the one-way transfer-time formula.
Evaluate the transfer time in seconds and days.
Check whether the one-way duration should be reported using the half-period or the full period of the transfer ellipse.
Give the final report sentence with the transfer duration and its relation to the transfer ellipse.
